label: Домик
description: A 10-sentence usage card for домик (little house).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Домик' is the masculine nominative subject of 'стоит'. 'Маленький' agrees in the masculine, and 'в лесу' gives the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Домик' is the inanimate masculine accusative object of 'построили', identical to the nominative. 'Уютный' agrees in the accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Около домика' uses the genitive 'домика' after 'около' to show proximity. 'Цветы' is the nominative subject of 'растут'.

missions.phrase: Мы идём к домику у реки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'К домику' uses the dative 'домику' after 'к' to express movement toward. 'У реки' adds a genitive location.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В домике' uses the prepositional 'домике' after 'в' to show where it is warm. A cosy descriptive sentence.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'За домиком' uses the instrumental 'домиком' after 'за' to express position behind. 'Огород' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantifier. 'Много' governs the genitive plural 'домиков'. 'Старых' agrees in the genitive plural. A natural way to count buildings.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Домик' is the accusative object of 'вижу', identical to the nominative for this inanimate noun. 'На холме' gives the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Из домика' uses the genitive 'домика' after 'из' to express coming out from. 'Старик' is the nominative subject of 'вышел'.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with instrumental predicate. 'Домик' is the nominative subject of 'кажется', and 'заброшенным' takes the instrumental as the predicate. 'Этот' points at it.
